newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR MIXED ON UNITS AT MONDAY'S CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR MIXED ON UNITS AT MONDAY'S CLOSE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on the U.S. dollar and pound sterling but registered losses against the mark and the rand at the close of Monday's interbank session, foreign exchange dealers said.
"The market seems to have closed a touch long. Everyone was rushing to sell towards the close of business, suggesting that the market was long," a dealer commented.
He said the local unit finished the day at 11.1350/1450 against the U.S. dollar, up from Friday's 11.1475/1575 and was at 17.8000/8300 from 17.8800/9100 against sterling.
It however slipped against the mark to close at 6.5200/5400 from 6.5000/5200 and was also indicated easier on the rand at 2.5000/5200 compared to 2.4900/5200.
